title: Choose entities, values, and services deliberately

questions.question: Which concept should be a value object?
options: A piece of evidence: a URL and an excerpt
A batch run with its own history
questions.explanation: Two pieces of evidence with the same URL and excerpt are interchangeable. The others have identities that persist over time.

questions.question: Two Company objects have the same name but different IDs. Are they equal?
options: Only if they have the same directory hint
No, because identity is the company ID
questions.explanation: Entities are equal by identity, so two different companies with one name stay distinct.

questions.question: Why is SuggestionPolicy a service rather than a method on Company?
options: The rule needs both a suggestion and a company, and belongs naturally to neither.
questions.explanation: A rule spanning several objects reads more clearly as its own named operation.
